posts.text: As some of you know, last summer I had the opportunity to travel to San Francisco and Intern at Uber. It was a truly amazing experience, and I was very grateful for the opportunity to show the company who I am and what I bring to the table. After a successful summer at Uber last year, I am happy to announce that I’m returning to Uber as a Software Engineering Intern in Toronto. I would like to give a special thanks to Austin Silva, who helped me throughout this process. I am excited to continue

Hello everyone, I am excited to share that I will join Uber as a SWE UberStar intern this summer! I want to give a huge thanks to Jessica Stubbs and Olayinka Olasoju for supporting and making this process easy for me. I am very excited about this upcoming summer and hope to learn a ton! Thanks to my friends and family who have supported me up until now, I could not have made it this far without you. I hope to make you all proud.
